events.verdict: Kessler (UTA) firms up over his left foot in Martin's (PHI) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.
Markkanen (UTA) goes to, and not through, Maxey's (PHI) space when he changes direction at the start of his drive on the perimeter.
Embiid (PHI) lowers his arm and initiates contact to Markkanen's (UTA wrist contesting his shot attempt.
Sexton (UTA) places his a steady hand against Maxey's (PHI) side as they move over the pick and the contact is marginal.
George's (PHI) left foot is already planted as incidental knee-to-knee contact occurs during Sexton's (UTA) drive to the basket. Any ensuing contact after the ball becomes loose is incidental.
George (PHI) and Kessler (UTA) both dive for the loose ball and get tangled up. A jump ball violation is correctly assessed.
A 24-second violation is correctly assessed.
George (PHI) contests the layup attempt and the contact that occurs with Kessler (UTA) after the release and follow through, is marginal.
Kessler (UTA) and George (PHI) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on George (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Kessler (UTA) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds and the 76ers are correctly given the possession.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in Clarkson's (UTA) path and releases away as he slips toward the basket.
Sexton (UTA) makes incidental hand-on-ball contact to briefly dislodge the ball from Embiid (PHI) during his dribble.
After the ball becomes loose, Sexton (UTA) and Embiid (PHI) engage and disengage with one another as they come together in pursuit of the loose ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Clarkson (UTA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Clarkson (UTA) extends his leg and initiates lower-body contact with George (PHI), affecting his fade-away shot attempt.
Utah is correctly assessed with a Delay of Game violation.
Sexton (UTA) hands off the ball in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path and marginal contact occurs as they disengage.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) and Sexton (UTA) engage and disengage in pursuit of the long rebound. The contact is marginal.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on George (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Kessler (UTA) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds and 76ers are correctly given the possession.
George (PHI) extends his arm backward as he cuts when contact occurs with Sexton's (UTA) face, affecting his ability to defend.
Williams (UTA) commits a take foul on George (PHI).
Martin (PHI) briefly places his hands against Clarkson (UTA) prior to correcting.
Sexton (UTA) establishes himself in Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) path and marginal contact ocurs to Oubre Jr.'s body during the screen.
Williams (UTA) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).
Martin (PHI) places a steady hand to Markkanen (UTA) side and does not apply force as he attempts to go for the errant entry pass.
